message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/jbig2dec && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jbig2dec/annex-h.jbig2').read_bytes()
for off in [100,120,140,160,180,200,220,240,260,280,300,320,340,360,380,400,420,440,460,480,500,520,540,560,580,600,620,640,660,680,700,720,740,760,780,800]:
    if off < len(src):
        d=bytearray(src)
        d[off] ^= 0xFF
        Path(f'/tmp/poc_{off}.jb2').write_bytes(d)
print('done')
PY
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PWD/.libs ./.libs/jbig2dec -q -o /dev/null /tmp/poc_100.jb2 >/tmp/out 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; tail -20 /tmp/out
